clips.title: The story
paras: The Riverglades is a contested river valley east of the Burning Steppes and Badlands, historically claimed by the Kingdom of Stormwind. Overrun by the Old Horde during the First War and largely abandoned by the crown, the region remains a battleground as local human loyalists clash with modern Horde outposts and local wildlife. It borders Redridge Mountains to the southwest, Swamp of Sorrows to the south, and faces Tanaris across the sea.

Historically part of the Kingdom of Stormwind, the Riverglades fell into ruin during the First War when the Old Horde swept through the region. Its central settlement, Sunnyglade, was sacked by the orcs, who spared its mage tower solely to study human sorcery before enslaving the surviving townsfolk. Though Stormwind soldiers mounted an effort to liberate the captives and rebuild, the kingdom eventually deemed the entire valley lost and diverted resources toward defending the core homelands. For years, the region remained largely cut off from formal crown support.

Despite being left behind by Stormwind's higher leadership, the human defenders never fully surrendered their homeland. Under Knight Commander Demar Brant of the legendary Brotherhood of the Horse, the remaining loyalists hold Farholde Keep as a bastion against the wilderness and hostile invaders. Meanwhile, the modern Horde maintains their own strong presence nearby at outposts like Rog'mar and Bolder'ok, ensuring that the ancient conflict over the glades continues to smolder.

Stretching along the coast of the Forbidding Sea, the Riverglades is flanked by mountainous terrain and winding waterways. Travelers on foot can cross west through Blackrock Pass to the Burning Steppes, wind southwest through Redridge Pass toward the Redridge Mountains, navigate south into the Swamp of Sorrows, or trek northwest past Twilight's Shroud into the Badlands. On the coast, Powderfuse Port provides sea passage connecting directly across the ocean to Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.
